notes.title: Actually Final Patch
notes.notes:
Just a small patch - we've received lots of feedback regarding the tutorial being too wordy, so it's been streamlined. You can replay the tutorial by clicking the button in the options menu if you've already finished it.

Please let us know if you think this new version is an improvement.

Also included is a couple of minor balance changes (notably, the Solar starting ship has the shard cannon moved to the turret slot for a much easier initial experience), and a fix for the HUD disappearing on level retries.

notes.title: Final Patch Before Early Access
notes.notes:
Barring any fatal bugs, this will be the last patch before Early Access. The playtest will be turned off to public access at that point, likely this weekend.

This patch finishes the Steam integration - all your resources and unlocks now sync with Steam. This does mean you'll be starting again from scratch, however, so apologies for that.

You'll notice also that the ships now have a cost to unlock, and the missions also now need to be unlocked in order (kill a medium or above boss on a level to unlock the next).

Thanks once again to all our wonderful testers. Click the copyright text on the main screen to see who they were :P
